condition: Beta CSS margin + frame publication + publication-time fit; one live controller, Chromium, real local PTY
method: A later registered ResizeObserver sees the product already fitted to the changed host, then applies terminal.resize(old.cols, old.rows), exactly the resized handler operation. The control ablates only the subsequent publication-time fit call. This is an induced ordering experiment, not a recorded network-echo trace.

ablation.intervention: Suppress only the second fit call (publication), retaining the first ResizeObserver fit

ptyMeaning: stty size reports rows first, columns second
limitations: No claim about frequency in natural traffic.
No same-principal ownership change or native-platform proof.
